description: Accounts in Hebrew. Late. Currency: muayyadi/medin. Most of the items listed are foodstuffs. The reference to this coinage type leaves 1415 CE as the chronological threshold for when the document could have been recorded, but it appears to be later based on the paleography: perhaps 16th- or 17th-century. Requires further examination.
